I'm also getting better at being able to identify and put into words WHY something felt hurtful or caused me anger. In a lifetime of being forced to repress and deny my own emotions, it's robbed me of the language to understand them and name them.

There have been times when I feel like "I'm angry for no good reason."\nI've started to be gentle with myself and just give myself permission to sit in that anger, feel it, and let it naturally ebb away rather than trying to force myself to change emotions, or berate myself.

And there have been times at work when I am angry. And I instinctively want to blame myself for feeling that way and bottle it up. But I can't live that way. I can't keep covering for other people's fuckups, either. People fuck up. I am allowed to be angry. It's an emotion.
